name: ParcelRush for WooCommerce
author: parcelrush

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce shipping workflow with ParcelRush

ParcelRush is the complete shipping solution for WooCommerce stores that want to save time, reduce costs, and eliminate shipping errors. Our platform connects seamlessly with your store to provide:

Key Features

  • Multi-Carrier Rate Comparison – Compare real-time shipping rates from UPS, FedEx, DHL, CTT, DPD and more
  • Automated Order Processing – Streamline fulfillment with intelligent order routing and batch processing
  • Label Generation – Print shipping labels directly from your dashboard
  • Real-Time Tracking – Keep customers informed with automatic tracking updates
  • Inventory Management – Sync stock levels across multiple warehouses and locations
  • Cost Optimization – AI-powered recommendations to reduce shipping costs
  • Multi-Platform Integration – Connect with Shopify, Amazon, eBay and other sales channels
  • Custom Shipping Rules – Set up automated workflows based on your business logic

Supported Carriers

  • FedEx (rates, tracking, labels)
  • DHL (international shipping)
  • CTT (Portugal postal service)
  • DPD (European delivery network)
  • And many more regional carriers

Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores shipping domestically and internationally
  • Multi-channel sellers managing inventory across platforms
  • Businesses looking to automate their shipping workflow
  • Stores wanting to reduce shipping costs and improve efficiency

Languages

ParcelRush is available in:
* English
* French (Français)
* Portuguese (Português)
* Spanish (Español)
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “ParcelRush”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/parcelrush directory
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  4. Go to ParcelRush menu in your admin dashboard

After Installation

  1. Click on “ParcelRush” in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Click “Connect to ParcelRush” to open the ParcelRush platform
  3. Sign up for a free account or log in if you already have one
  4. Follow the connection wizard to link your WooCommerce store
  5. Configure your shipping preferences and start optimizing!
sections.faq:
Is ParcelRush free to use?

ParcelRush offers a free plan to get started. Premium features and higher volume limits are available with paid plans.

Which carriers are supported?

We support major carriers including UPS, FedEx, DHL, CTT, DPD and many regional carriers. New carriers are added regularly.

Can I use ParcelRush with other e-commerce platforms?

Yes! ParcelRush integrates with Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, eBay, Wix and other major platforms.

Do I need to install anything else?

No, this lightweight plugin only provides the connection interface. All shipping functionality runs on the secure ParcelRush platform.

How do I get shipping rates?

Once connected, ParcelRush automatically pulls your order data and provides real-time shipping rates from multiple carriers.

Is my data secure?

Absolutely. ParcelRush uses enterprise-grade security with encrypted connections and complies with international data protection standards.

Can I manage multiple warehouses?

Yes, ParcelRush supports multi-warehouse inventory management and intelligent order routing.

What if I need help?

Our support team is available via the ParcelRush platform, email, and live chat. We also provide comprehensive documentation and video tutorials.
